1. Schema contract, `packages/schema/src/share.ts` (relative imports end in `.js`):
   - `SHARE_ID_RE = /^[sl][0-9a-hjkmnp-tv-z]{25}$/`, `OWNER_TOKEN_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/`, `shareIdSchema = z.string().regex(SHARE_ID_RE)`.
   - `shareCreateRequestSchema`: `{ kind: z.enum(['snapshot','living']), includedTypes: z.array(z.string()).max(PAGES_MAX), payload: z.unknown() }` (payload is validated separately by `validateSharePayload`, which checks versions before shape).
   - `shareCreateResponseSchema`: `{ id: shareIdSchema, kind, url: z.url(), ownerToken: z.string().regex(OWNER_TOKEN_RE), publishedAt: z.iso.datetime(), etag: z.string() }`.
   - `shareGetResponseSchema`: `{ id, kind, publishedAt, updatedAt (both z.iso.datetime()), adult: z.boolean(), includedTypes: z.array(z.string()), payload: z.unknown() }`.
   - `apiErrorSchema`: `{ error: { code: z.string(), message: z.string(), details: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional() } }`.
   - `shareRecordSchema` (IndexedDB `shares` row, D-08): `{ shareId: shareIdSchema, kind, characterId: z.uuidv4(), ownerToken: z.string().nullable(), includedTypes: z.array(z.string()), lastPublishedAt: z.iso.datetime(), etag: z.string().nullable() }`.
   - Inferred types `ShareCreateRequest`, `ShareCreateResponse`, `ShareGetResponse`, `ApiError`, `ShareRecord`.
2. `packages/schema/src/migrate.ts`:
   - A private `lookupPlugin(registry, type)` returning `Object.hasOwn(registry, type) ? registry[type] : undefined`; use it in `migrateSubDocument`, `validateSubDocument` and `validateCharacter` so a `constructor` page type is an `UnsupportedVersionError`, not a TypeError (the server now feeds this function untrusted input).
   - `computeAdult(pages: readonly SubDocument[], registry = SCHEMA_REGISTRY): boolean`, true when any page's plugin exists and has `adult === true` (the Discretion note: this did not exist yet; web and API share it).
   - `collectAllImageRefs(source: { core: { portrait: ImageRef | null }; pages: readonly SubDocument[] }, registry = SCHEMA_REGISTRY): ImageRef[]`: portrait first, then each known page's `collectImageRefs(data)`, de-duplicated by hash keeping first occurrence. It accepts both a Character and a SharePayload.
   - `validateSharePayload(raw: unknown, registry = SCHEMA_REGISTRY): SharePayload`, mirroring `validateCharacter`'s fixed order: root object with a string `schemaVersion` and a `pages` array (else `InvalidDocumentError(['root'])`); envelope version in `ENVELOPE_SUPPORTED_VERSIONS` (else `UnsupportedVersionError('envelope', v)`); every page's type/version supported (else `UnsupportedVersionError(type, version)`); then `migrateEnvelope`, `validateSubDocument` per page (adult comes from the registry), then `sharePayloadSchema.safeParse`, mapping failures to `InvalidDocumentError` with issue paths.
   - Export all three plus the new share.ts symbols and types from `index.ts`.
